data.title: Coalition: Air Defenses Intercept and Destroy Two Ballistic Missiles Launched by Terrorist Houthi Militia toward Jazan Region
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that air defenses intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward Jazan Region.
    Major General Al-Malki said that debris from the interception fell in the Al-Shaqiq area, and the relevant authorities are responding at the site.
    -- SPA
18:50 Local Time 15:50 GMT
0058
